# Background
This script produces a cross table of maternal features and birth outcomes for the 213 mother-child dyads included in analysis. Features of interest are selected, categorized, mutated as appropriate, recombined, and then put in a cross table of "Healthy" vs "SVN". Samples with exclusion criteria are also removed. 

## Packages

```{r Packages}

#if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
#  install.packages("BiocManager")
#BiocManager::install()

#for accessing phyloseq object
#BiocManager::install("phyloseq")
library(phyloseq)

#for data organization and visualization
#install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)

#for locating files
#install.packages("here")
library(here)

#for creating crosstables
#install.packages("crosstable")
library(crosstable)
```

## Load data
```{r Loading data}

load(here("results/filtered_dada_2_output_environment.RData"))


```


## Data organization
### Extracting information into data frames

```{r Sample data to data frame}
#retrieving sample data: this could also be done using the Meta_data_2 data frame

sample_data <- ps_analysis_2@sam_data %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Sample.ID")

nrow(sample_data) #237

#removing twins from the cohort
sample_data <- sample_data %>% 
  filter(Twins == 2)
nrow(sample_data) #235

```
```{r}
extra_birth_outcomes <- read.csv(here("extra_birth_outcomes.csv"))
extra_birth_outcomes$Study_ID_1 <- extra_birth_outcomes$Q6

extra_birth_outcomes <- extra_birth_outcomes %>% select(-c(ID1, Q6))

extra_birth_outcomes$F02A08K <- as.factor(extra_birth_outcomes$F02A08K)
extra_birth_outcomes$F02A08L <- as.factor(extra_birth_outcomes$F02A08L)
extra_birth_outcomes$F02A07 <- as.factor(extra_birth_outcomes$F02A07)
```



### Seperating/combining information into data frames based on categories
This is certainly not necessary to do, but helps for modulation of the table. 
Any additional transformation of the variables are also conducted.

```{r Maternal Serology data frame}

Maternal_serology <- select(sample_data, Sample.ID, Study_ID_1, Anemia_Binary, inflammation_AGP_cat, inflammation_CRP_cat, calprotectin_ug.g) %>% 
mutate(inflammation_calprotectin_cat = case_when(calprotectin_ug.g >= 50 ~ "Elevated Calprotectin", calprotectin_ug.g < 50 ~ "Normal Calprotectin")) %>% 
  select(-calprotectin_ug.g)
#50 micrograms/gram cut off for normal/elevated calprotectin

```

```{r child info}

child <- select(sample_data, Sample.ID, Study_ID_1, Sex) %>% mutate(Sex = factor(Sex))

```


```{r cofactors}

cofactors <- select(sample_data, Sample.ID, Study_ID_1, Maternal_age_cat, Maternal_education_cat, Parity_cat, Wealth_index, BMI_cat, BMI)

#Making sure each variable is seem as a factor.
cofactors <- cofactors %>% 
  mutate(Maternal_age_cat = factor(Maternal_age_cat, levels = c("<18", "18-35", ">35"))) %>% 
  mutate(Maternal_education_cat = factor(Maternal_education_cat, levels = c("No Education", "1-5", "6-10", ">10"))) %>% 
  mutate(Parity_cat = factor(Parity_cat, levels = c("0", "1-2", ">2"))) %>% 
  mutate(Wealth_index = factor(Wealth_index, levels = c("Poorest", "Poorer", "middle", "Ricehest", "Richer"))) %>% 
  mutate(BMI_cat = factor(BMI_cat, levels = c("Underweight", "Healthy Weight", "Overweight", "Obese"))) 


```


```{r Enteric Pathogens data frame}

aEPEC <- select(sample_data, Sample.ID, Study_ID_1, aEPEC_cat)

```

```{r birth outcomes data frame}
#creating the SGA outcome that combines large for gestational age and normal into one category. Also creating the "Single_outcome_SVN" outcome which removes miscarriages and the like from the SVN category. 

Birth_outcomes <- select(sample_data, Sample.ID, Study_ID_1, Born_Alive, Percential_weight.GA, Birth_weight_cat, GA_birth_binary, GA_birth, Birth_weight) %>% 
  mutate(Percential_weight.GA_2 = case_when(Percential_weight.GA == "normal" | Percential_weight.GA == "LGA" ~ "Normal", Percential_weight.GA == "SGA" ~ "SGA")) %>% 
   mutate(SVN = case_when(Percential_weight.GA_2 == "SGA" | Birth_weight_cat == "Low Birth Weight" | GA_birth_binary == "Preterm" ~ "SVN", .default = "Other")) %>% 
  mutate(Single_outcome_SVN = case_when(Born_Alive == "1" & Percential_weight.GA_2 == "Normal" & Birth_weight_cat == "Normal Weight" & GA_birth_binary == "Term" ~ "Healthy", Born_Alive == "1" & SVN == "SVN" ~ "SVN", .default = "Other"))


```


## cross table for SVN vs healthy

```{r create data frame with all variables of interest}
#creating dataframe with variables of interest. Filtering out participants with miscarriages etc.

SVN_ct_df <- Birth_outcomes %>% 
  #full_join(cofactors) %>% 
  full_join(child) %>% 
  #full_join(Maternal_serology) %>% 
  #full_join(aEPEC) %>% 
  left_join(extra_birth_outcomes) %>% 
  select(-c(Study_ID_1)) %>% 
  filter(GA_birth_binary == "Preterm") %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "Sample.ID")  %>% 
  filter(Single_outcome_SVN != "Other")

nrow(SVN_ct_df)


```


```{r cross table}
#making the cross table
SVN_CT <- crosstable(SVN_ct_df, by = Single_outcome_SVN, total="both", test = TRUE)

SVN_CT

```
